An unusual type of '''spongy growth''' could be found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zebitrope IV]]. It had a symbiotic relationship with a [[Unidentified lizard (Zebitrope IV)|species]] of [[Lizard/Legends|lizard]] that also inhabited the planet. The spongy growths offered the [[Reptile/Legends|reptiles]] nurture and concealment.<ref name="LCFO">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]''</ref>
